boundaries.issue: partial for correct individual clauses without whole conjunction overlaps defer wording
boundaries.proposal: defer only when no interpretable individual/whole conjunction judgment is supplied; partial when correct component judgments form an observable proper subset but whole conjunction judgment is absent; meets requires whole result and conjunctive condition

boundaries.issue: repeating group names and actual numeric values versus unambiguous supplied comparison reference
boundaries.proposal: record identification and numeric-ground completeness separately; permit referential ellipsis only when it uniquely binds provided groups/claims; never infer a new referent or convert missing requested numeric evidence into full evidence

boundaries.issue: actual value completeness can be incorrectly charged to units
boundaries.proposal: units scores indicator, year/period, scale and unit; numeric evidence completeness belongs to comparison evidence; implicit year/period acceptance requires a separately frozen coding rule
explicit wrong grounds fail the corresponding evidence facet; retain correct formal conjunction separately if observable; do not infer single overall mastery from mixed facet results

boundaries.issue: correct copied prose versus independent performance
boundaries.proposal: semantic quality remains observable; explicit pre-answer exposure is ineligible and absent reliable logs is defer, independently of meaning score
